name: csi
description: CSI skills for coding agents: csi (drive the user's real Chrome browser — navigate, click, type, screenshot, save PDF — via the local daemon), csi-e2e (turn natural-language browser scenarios into replayable e2e regression suites).
skillInstructions:
CSI skills tool mapping for Kimi Code:

- When a CSI skill drives the browser (navigate, click, fill, snapshot, screenshot, save_as_pdf, etc.), issue `curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/command` requests with Kimi Code's `Bash` tool; the skill documents the exact JSON payloads.
- When a CSI skill returns a screenshot or PDF file path, view it with `Read`.
- When csi-e2e writes or refines `e2e/cases/*.md`, `e2e/suites/*.mjs`, or `e2e/lib/*.mjs`, use `Write` and `Edit`; locate existing cases and suites with `Grep` and `Glob`.
- When replaying suites (`node e2e/run.mjs`), use `Bash`.
- When a skill asks to fetch a URL or search for documentation, use `FetchURL` and `WebSearch`.
- Invoke CSI skills with Kimi Code's native `Skill` tool.

interface.shortDescription: Let the agent drive your real Chrome browser
interface.longDescription: CSI skills let the agent control the user's real Chrome browser — navigate, click, type, read pages, screenshot, save PDFs — through the local csi daemon, using the user's actual login sessions; csi-e2e turns natural-language browser scenarios into replayable e2e regression suites.
